That night he wrote a reply, sealed it in a jar, and tossed it into the tide, wondering who might find it and whether any message ever truly arrives.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一只刚刚合上眼的巨兽，楼宇的轮廓在薄雾里起伏。街灯把梧桐叶照成半透明的金色，清洁车缓缓驶过，水痕在路面上闪着细碎的光。便利店还亮着，店员靠着柜台打盹。远处高架上有车驶过，声音像潮汐，短暂地漫上来，又退回去。有人在窗后翻身，有人刚下班，有人准备出发。城市不说话，只把无数梦轻轻含在嘴里。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself on a smaller version.\n- It needs a base case, like a tiny doll that does not open, so it can stop.\n- Imagine walking down stairs: each step is the same action, but closer to the bottom."}
